tools.name: Microsoft Copilot
tools.quote: Microsoft’s Copilot is accessible to all MU students, and we currently have a data agreement in place with Microsoft, which means that our use of Copilot is GDPR-compliant.
The same protection does not apply when you use free or paid tools which are not supported by MU.

data.quote: Never put your personal data or anyone else’s into a GenAI tool.
Personal Data such as your name, email address, and your work could also be used for training or other purposes without your permission.

safeguards.quote: To use Copilot, students should log in with their MU login and password in the Edge browser.

legal.quote: GDPR is about your personal data rights. Never put your personal data or anyone else’s into a GenAI tool.
